name: Ao no Ballade ~Ballade de azure.~
original_name: 碧のバラード ～Ballade de azure.～
source:
Akira is an amateur musician aiming to become a professional. On a rainy day he meets a girl while working a part-time job. She turns out out to be a daughter of a famous musical producer. Her father becomes the biggest barrier on the way to love as he promises Akira to disqualify him from a musical contest if he continues to pursue producer's daughter. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
业余音乐人亮一心想成为职业音乐家。
雨天兼职时，他遇见一名女孩，后来发现她是知名音乐制作人的女儿。
制作人父亲成为爱情路上最大的阻碍：他威胁亮，只要继续追求自己的女儿，就取消他参加音乐比赛的资格。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
